description: Researches a topic by finding YouTube videos, reading their transcripts, and producing a structured markdown file that teaches the user about the topic and summarizes each video.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: The subject to research on YouTube

inputs.name: audience_level
inputs.description: The knowledge level to pitch the teaching doc at

inputs.name: num_videos
inputs.description: Number of videos to find and synthesize

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: Where to save the output markdown file

outputs.name: notes_file
outputs.description: Markdown file containing a synthesized teaching section followed by per-video summaries with YouTube links and timestamp highlights

side_effects: If output file already exists for the topic, new content is appended rather than overwriting

steps.name: prompt_user
steps.description: Ask the user for: topic, audience_level, num_videos (default 5), output_path (default YouTube Notes folder)

steps.name: check_existing_file
steps.description: Check if <topic>.md already exists at output_path. If yes, load it for append mode.

steps.name: search_youtube
steps.description: Search YouTube for the topic. Rank results by a mix of recency and view count. Pull top candidates.

steps.name: fetch_transcripts
steps.description: Fetch transcripts via yt-dlp or YouTube Data API. If a video has no transcript, skip it and pull the next candidate. Repeat until num_videos valid transcripts are found or candidates are exhausted.

steps.name: summarize_videos
steps.description: For each video, extract key points and notable timestamp highlights.

steps.name: synthesize
steps.description: Write a teaching doc section drawing across all videos, pitched at the specified audience_level.

steps.name: write_output
steps.description: Save or append the markdown file at output_path. Structure: teaching section first, per-video summaries with links and timestamps below.

error_handling.behavior: Skip silently and pull the next search candidate

error_handling.scenario: Fewer than num_videos transcripts found after exhausting search results
error_handling.behavior: Warn the user, then proceed with however many valid videos were found
Append new content; do not overwrite existing notes

test_cases.expected_output: Markdown file created at default path with teaching section and 3 video summaries including YouTube links

test_cases.precondition: tc_01 has already run and output file exists
test_cases.expected_output: New content appended to existing file without overwriting prior notes

test_cases.description: No transcripts available in top results
test_cases.expected_output: Agent searches beyond initial results, warns user if insufficient transcripts found, outputs file with however many valid videos were found
